question:
Let $f: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x) = \lfloor x \rfloor + \lfloor -x \rfloor + 1$, where $\lfloor \cdot \rfloor$ is the greatest integer function.

(a) Prove $f$ is a constant function and find its value.

(b) If $g: \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is defined by $g(x) = |x| - |x-1| + |x+1|$, find the range of $g$.

(c) Define the relation $R$ on $\mathbb{R}$ by $x R y \iff f(x) = f(y)$. Prove $R$ is an equivalence relation and describe the equivalence classes.

options.A:
(a) $f$ is constant with value $1$.
(b) Range of $g$ is $\mathbb{R}$.
(c) $R$ is an equivalence relation with only one equivalence class $\mathbb{R}$.
options.B:
(a) $f(x)=1$ if $x\in\mathbb{Z}$ and $f(x)=0$ if $x\notin\mathbb{Z}$, so it is not constant.
(b) Range of $g$ is $[0,\infty)$.
(c) $R$ is an equivalence relation with equivalence classes $\mathbb{Z}$ and $\mathbb{R}\setminus\mathbb{Z}$.
options.C:
(a) $f$ is constant with value $0$.
(b) Range of $g$ is $[1,\infty)$.
(c) $R$ is not an equivalence relation because it is not reflexive.
options.D:
(a) $f(x)=x$ for all real $x$.
(b) Range of $g$ is $(-\infty,0]$.
(c) $R$ is symmetric only.
